mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of carrying out research in an objective and controlled fashion so that precision is maximized and specific conclusions can be drawn regarding a hypothesis statement."

Experimental Design Experimental design is the process of carrying out research in an objective and controlled fashion so that precision is maximized and specific conclusions can be drawn regarding a hypothesis statement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trial or experiment that is carried out or run before the real experiment."
Uniformity trial is a trial or experiment that is carried out or run before the real experiment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an abbreviated version of the paper, written for people who may never read the complete version."
An abstract is an abbreviated version of the paper, written for people who may never read the complete version.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification presenting the author's research and findings."
A thesis or dissertation is a document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification presenting the author's research and findings.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a planned investigation that is carried out to obtain additional knowledge in order to solve identified problems and to obtain solutions to the problems."
Field experimentation is a planned investigation that is carried out to obtain additional knowledge in order to solve identified problems and to obtain solutions to the problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ability of a scientist/student to carry out or measure precisely what is intended to be measured."
Accuracy refers to the ability of a scientist/student to carry out or measure precisely what is intended to be measured.
fib: ______ is the science of application of qualitative and quantitative techniques for making inductive inference.
Statistics is the science of application of qualitative and quantitative techniques for making inductive inference.
______ are a common method to visually illustrate relationships in the data.
Graphics are a common method to visually illustrate relationships in the data.

______ is used to show the relationship between two variables and whether their values change in a consistent way, such as analyzing the relationship between the concentration levels of two different proteins.

A scattergram is used to show the relationship between two variables and whether their values change in a consistent way, such as analyzing the relationship between the concentration levels of two different proteins.
______ is a planned investigation that is carried out to obtain additional knowledge in order to solve identified problems and to obtain solutions to the problems.
An experiment is a planned investigation that is carried out to obtain additional knowledge in order to solve identified problems and to obtain solutions to the problems.
______ means getting the experimental procedure right such as choice of right design make sure that there is correct randomization, replication etc . to minimize experimental error.

Precision in experimentation means getting the experimental procedure right such as choice of right design make sure that there is correct randomization, replication etc . to minimize experimental error.

A journal is a periodical publication in which scholarship relating to a particular academic discipline is published.
